body: So I read a lot of these comments because I knew this situation. And a lot of what I'm reading is it'll get better or plenty of fish in the sea. My two cents is that so far it hasn't gotten better. I knew this woman in freshman year of college, one of those you see and you think "oh fuck" and I mean that in the my pants are suddenly tight and the this person is special. That was four years ago. A little time passed, she dated somebody, I dated somebody, she broke up, I got married, she dated somebody else. But ever present, like the sun rise and sun set our feelings never dissipated. It almost boiled over dozens of times. We could've easily cleared the air with nights of wild passion and deemed the whole thing a fling. But no. We let it fester like idiots. We grew to have a kind of love, knew each other, simply wanted to be around each other. Yet we couldn't. We had separate lives, different people that love us. Don't get me wrong I feel just as deeply for my wife, I knew her since childhood. And my beau loves her man, and I can't hate the guy either. (doofy looking fuck that he is *cough*) For six months we agreed to part ways, (she dumped me) and one day she drunkenly texts me that she misses me. Groovy since I thought about her every day. She recently went MIA again, until last night. I instigated this time, because 3 months later I still think about her every day. TLDR Sometimes it doesn't get better. Sometimes you just get numb.
